overview: Couple Cups is a social event advertisement platform on the Internet Computer. Users browse and post paid event invitations — cinema, restaurants, gaming, walks, and more — and connect with someone to share the experience. Features include Internet Identity login, Stripe payments, ICP blob storage for photos, 8-language support, and a fully responsive DaisyUI interface.
features: Public feed with filterable event advertisements
Profile management with photo upload (ICP blob storage)
Advertisement creation with Stripe payment checkout ($1 USD)
Auto light/dark theme per system preference
My Advertisements dashboard with payment retry
Responsive DaisyUI design with Lucide icons
